messages.content: Find a yoga retreat in New York that includes vegetarian meals and spa services.

message.content:
I’m afraid I don’t have a dedicated API call that will pull out *yoga‑retreat* listings with those exact criteria (vegetarian meals + spa services) in New York. However, here are several well‑known spots you might consider—most of them run their own wellness programs, serve plant‑based food, and feature full spa facilities: | Venue | Location | What makes it fit your request | |-------|----------|--------------------------------| | **The Peninsula New York** | Midtown Manhattan | • Spa & fitness center
• Vegetarian/vegan options available upon request
• Weekend “Wellness Packages” often bundle yoga classes | | **Ritz‑Carlton, New York** | Upper East Side | • On‑site spa & pool
• Customizable meal plans including vegetarian choices
• Offers private yoga sessions during stays | | **Four Seasons Hotel New York Downtown** | Lower Manhattan | • Full‑service spa & fitness studio
• Menu designed around seasonal produce, many vegan/veg options
• Can arrange daily yoga or meditation workshops | | **Hyatt Regency New York City Hall** | Financial District | • Wellness lounge & sauna
• Vegetarian-friendly menus
• Partners with nearby yoga studios for day‑long retreats | | **Yogi's Kitchen & Studio (Westchester)** | Bronx / Westchester border | • Dedicated yoga studio hosting multi‑day retreats
• In‑house kitchen serves exclusively vegetarian dishes
• Includes massage & hydrotherapy treatments | ### How to book one of these: 1. **Visit the property’s website** → look under “Packages,” “Wellness,” or “Specialty Dining.” 2. **Call the reservations desk** and specify: - You’re looking for a yoga retreat style stay. - Request vegetarian meals throughout. - Ask about bundled spa services (massages, facials, saunas). 3. **Ask for confirmation** that all requested items are covered in the price quote so nothing surprises you later. If none of the above fits perfectly, another route is to contact a reputable yoga studio in NYC (e.g., **YogaWorks**, **Bodhi Tree**, **New York School of Meditation**) and inquire whether they partner with nearby boutique hotels or spas for curated retreats. Many studios now collaborate with local accommodations to create turnkey packages that cover lodging, meals, yoga instruction, and spa treatments—all tailored to vegetarians. Let me know if you'd like help drafting an email template for inquiries, or if there's anything else I can do!
